response.description: In early November 2025, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:  Azure SQL Hyperscale now supports multiple geo-secondary replicas, making it easier to design and deploy disaster recovery topology spanning multiple regions. Learn more. Azure SQL Database enables you to restart your database in the Azure portal.  The portal uses the same API that is available for PowerShell, REST, and Azure CLI.  Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for early November 2025
